subject: AWS Marketplace visibility options & co-sell badging
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aws-partner.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility and badging — quick questions

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this on — Marketplace Ops flagged Redwood’s upcoming listing for an eligibility check. A couple quick things we need from your side to route this for co-sell: 

- Confirmation of target visibility: public listing vs partner-only vs private-offer. Each has different onboarding hooks and lead flows.
- A single-sheet matrix that maps which SKUs/features you want to display on the product page vs which are behind private offers (pricing tiers, enterprise-only features).
- Any submitted copies/images we can use for the AWS product page (short description, 2–3 benefit bullets, hero image).

For badge eligibility: please share evidence of customer references and any joint GTM commitments (logos, named pilots, sales plays). We typically need at least one named customer and a co-sell playbook to start the advanced badging conversation.

Can you send the items or a timeline? If easier, we can do a 30-minute sync next week to walk through the badge matrix together.

Thanks — I’ve CC’d Marketplace Ops.

Sam Patel
Principal Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
Marketplace Partnerships

> - Any submitted copies/images we can use for the AWS product page (short description, 2–3 benefit bullets, hero image).
> 
> For badge eligibility: please share evidence of customer references and any joint GTM commitments (logos, named pilots, sales plays).

Hi Sam — appreciate the clear list. Attaching a draft pack to get the ball rolling. Quick responses below and proposed next steps.

Short answers:
- Visibility: primary plan is a public listing (to support self-serve trials) with two private-offer SKUs for enterprise and channel partners.
- SKU mapping: attached matrix (co-sell_badge_matrix_v1.xlsx) — column A lists public SKU, col B is private offer mapping; Karthik can confirm technical SKU names.
- Assets: attaching a lightweight product page draft (redwood_product_page_draft_v2.docx) and our hero asset PDF (aws_listing_assets_v3.pdf). Marissa has suggested edits on the benefit bullets — see inline comments.

GTM / badge evidence:
- Named customer: AcmeCorp is mid-pilot and has agreed to be a reference (Taylor King is CC’d on future coordination).
- Joint GTM: we have a co-sell play draft and an initial named pilot doc; I’ve marked the rows in the matrix where we propose co-sell treatment.

Next steps:
1) Marissa + Karthik to confirm copy and SKU mapping by EOD Tue.
2) I’ll upload the final pack to your HubSpot link and request official Marketplace review on Wed.
3) If that works for you, let’s schedule a 30 minute sync Wed 11/25 10:00am PT to align on badging criteria and timeline.

Thanks — attaching the three files now.

—
Chloe Martin
Partner Growth Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility and badging — quick questions

Thanks Chloe — quick copy pass and a few suggested structural changes for the product page draft. Inline highlights below: 

- Short description (headline): recommend pivot from technical-first to outcome-first. Suggested: "Redwood Inference — predictable, high-throughput LLM inference for production apps."
- Benefit bullets: tighten to three with metrics where possible. Suggested bullets: 1) "<60ms median gen latency (dedicated GPU)" 2) "40% avg cost reduction via batching & quantization" 3) "SLA-backed uptime for enterprise deployments".
- CTA: prefer "Start a free trial" + "Request enterprise demo" (two-button layout).

On the SKU matrix: Karthik — can you confirm the internal SKU identifiers we will publish vs the private-offer SKUs? We should avoid exposing advanced feature flags in the public SKU table.

Also attaching a one-pager we use for partner badge audits (partner_badge_evidence_template.pdf). I think that will speed the AWS review.

Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Sam — thanks for the quick review and for routing Marketplace Ops. Quick summary and asks so we can close this week: 

Decisions we made (per attachments):
- Listing visibility: public product page + two private-offer SKUs for enterprise and channel partner pricing.
- Product page copy: updated per Marissa’s pass (see attached redwood_product_page_draft_v2_final.docx).
- Evidence: attached partner_badge_evidence_template filled for AcmeCorp (Taylor has approved).

Requests from Marketplace Ops:
- Please confirm the badging checklist items we need to submit to start the advanced co-sell badge review. If there’s a preferred intake form, point me at the DocuSign / Jira / Marketplace intake URL.
- Confirm whether the private-offer SKUs can be configured to route leads to both Redwood Sales and an AWS partner contact (we want to ensure co-sell leads are routed correctly).

Scheduling: I booked the 30 minute sync for Wed 11/25 10:00am PT in case you want to walk the matrix live — if you need a different time, happy to adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to intake.

—
